title: Bifunctional architecture enables substrate catalysis and channeling in Paracoccus TMAO demethylase.
authors: Thach, Trung; Dhanabalan, KanagaVijayan; Maurya, Shiwangi; Han-Hallett, Yu; Quan, Senwei; Allison, Jane; Ramanathan, Gurunath; Subramanian, Ramaswamy
one_liner_zh: 该文通过冷冻电镜结构和靶向分子动力学揭示TDM酶底物通道化机制，虽以酶结构为核心但侧重实验表征，计算模拟仅辅助验证，方法贡献较弱。
abstract: Substrate channeling enhances efficiency and prevents toxicity by directing unstable intermediates between active sites. Trimethylamine N-oxide demethylase (TDM) degrades trimethylamine N-oxide (TMAO) to dimethylamine and formaldehyde (HCHO), but the fate of HCHO has remained unclear. We report cryo-EM structures of TDM in apo, substrate-, and product-bound states that reveal a previously unknown channeling pathway. Combined structural, biochemical, and target molecular dynamics analyses show that HCHO is generated in a catalytic core and guided through a tunnel to a remote tetrahydrofolate (THF)-binding site, where it forms methylene-THF. Thus, TDM emerges as a bifunctional enzyme that unites TMAO demethylation with one-carbon transfer, providing a mechanistic explanation for its role in metabolic efficiency and detoxification.
abstract_zh: 底物通道化通过将不稳定中间体引导至活性位点之间，提高了效率并防止毒性。三甲胺N-氧化物脱甲基酶（TDM）将三甲胺N-氧化物（TMAO）降解为二甲胺和甲醛（HCHO），但HCHO的去向此前尚不清楚。我们报道了TDM在脱辅基、底物结合和产物结合状态下的冷冻电镜结构，揭示了一条此前未知的通道化途径。结合结构、生化和靶向分子动力学分析表明，HCHO在催化核心中生成，并通过隧道引导至远端四氢叶酸（THF）结合位点，在那里形成亚甲基-THF。因此，TDM显现为一种双功能酶，将TMAO脱甲基与一碳转移相结合，为其在代谢效率和解毒中的作用提供了机制解释。
